title: Muscle Energy Technique — Using the Patient's Own Contraction

hook.en: A gentle contraction, a pause, and a new range. Learn how muscle energy technique works, when to use it and how to dose it so it stays comfortable.
hook.ur: Halki contraction, thora ruk jana, aur nayi range. Muscle energy technique kaise kaam karti hai, kab istemal karni hai aur dose kaise dena hai taake aaram se rahe, seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll perform post-isometric relaxation and reciprocal inhibition correctly, set the force and timing, and explain why the effect is real but its mechanism is still debated.
goal.ur: End tak aap post-isometric relaxation aur reciprocal inhibition sahi karenge, force aur timing set karenge, aur samjha sakenge ke asar asli hai lekin uska mechanism abhi bhi behes talab hai.

text.en: In **muscle energy technique (MET)** the patient does the work. You place the joint or muscle at a precise point, the patient makes a **gentle, controlled contraction** against your counter-pressure, then relaxes, and you move to a new end of range. It can lengthen a tight muscle, improve joint range, or help strengthen a weak muscle, depending on how you use it.
text.ur: **Muscle energy technique (MET)** mein kaam patient karta hai. Aap joint ya muscle ko ek durust point par rakhte hain, patient aap ke counter-pressure ke khilaf **halki, qabu mein contraction** karta hai, phir relax hota hai, aur aap range ke naye sirre par le jate hain. Yeh tight muscle ko lamba kar sakti hai, joint range behtar kar sakti hai, ya kamzor muscle ko mazboot karne mein madad de sakti hai, is par munhasir ke aap kaise istemal karte hain.

text.en: It is like opening a stiff door: pushing against it hard makes it jam, but a small push, a pause and then a gentle move forward lets the hinge give a little more each time. A hard contraction jams the muscle; a light one followed by relaxation lets the range open.
text.ur: Yeh akarhe darwaze ko kholne ki tarah hai: zor se dabane se woh phans jata hai, lekin chhota dhakka, thora ruknaa aur phir halka aage barhna har baar hinge ko thora aur dheela kar deta hai. Zor ki contraction muscle ko phansati hai; halki contraction ke baad relax range kholta hai.

steps.title: Find the first barrier
steps.detail: Move the muscle to the point where you first feel resistance, and stop before pain. This is the starting point, not the end of range. || Pehla barrier dhoondein

steps.title: Ask for a light contraction
steps.detail: The patient pushes gently against your hand, using only about 20% of their effort, for about 5 to 10 seconds, and you hold the position still. || Halki contraction maangein

steps.title: Relax, then take up the slack
steps.detail: Ask for a full relax, wait a moment for the muscle to let go, then move to the new barrier without stretching into pain. || Relax karwayein aur slack lein

steps.title: Repeat three to five times
steps.detail: Repeat from the new barrier, then retest the range and the symptoms. Stop when the range stops improving. || Teen se paanch baar dohrayein

question.en: What effort should the patient use for a standard PIR contraction?
question.ur: Standard PIR contraction mein patient kitna effort lagaye?

feedback.en: A maximal effort strains the muscle and does not help the range.
feedback.ur: Maximal effort muscle ko strain karta hai aur range mein madad nahi karta.

feedback.en: That is a static stretch, not MET.
feedback.ur: Yeh static stretch hai, MET nahi.

text.en: A light effort, about 20% of their maximum
text.ur: Halka effort, apni maximum ka takriban 20%

feedback.en: Yes — a light contraction relaxes the muscle; a hard one tires it and makes the muscle tense.
feedback.ur: Haan — halki contraction muscle ko relax karti hai; zor ki contraction use thakati hai aur tight kar deti hai.

title.en: Two ways to use the contraction
title.ur: Contraction istemal karne ke do tareeqay

rows.en: The muscle feels more relaxed after an isometric contraction, so it stretches further
rows.ur: Isometric contraction ke baad muscle zyada relax mehsoos hota hai, is liye zyada khinchta hai

rows.en: Contracting one muscle is thought to calm its opposite, so the tight one lets go
rows.ur: Ek muscle ki contraction se uska ulta muscle shaant hone ka khayal hai, is liye tight muscle chhor deta hai

rows.en: Joint restriction or a weak muscle, with a stronger contraction
rows.ur: Joint ki rukawat ya kamzor muscle, mazboot contraction ke saath

rows.en: Use the contraction to move a joint or to build force, not only to relax
rows.ur: Contraction se joint hilana ya force banana, sirf relax karna nahi

text.en: **Light, hold, relax, move.** About 20% effort, 5 to 10 seconds, wait for the muscle to let go, then take up the new range.
text.ur: **Halka, rokein, relax, hilayein.** Takriban 20% effort, 5 se 10 second, muscle ke chhorne ka intezar, phir nayi range lein.

text.en: **Using too much force or stretching into pain.** A hard contraction or a forced stretch tightens the muscle and can bring on soreness. If you cannot stay inside the patient's comfort, the technique is wrong for that muscle on that day.
text.ur: **Bohat zyada force ya dard mein stretch.** Zor ki contraction ya zabardasti stretch muscle ko tight karta hai aur dard la sakta hai. Agar aap patient ke aaram ke andar nahi reh sakte to us din us muscle ke liye technique ghalat hai.

question.en: A patient's hamstring stops at a point where they feel a mild stretch. What is the best next step in PIR?
question.ur: Patient ki hamstring ek point par ruk jati hai jahan halka stretch mehsoos hota hai. PIR mein behtar agla qadam kya hai?

text.en: Pull the leg further into pain
text.ur: Taang ko dard mein aur khenchein

feedback.en: Forcing the stretch is not MET.
There is more range to gain.
feedback.ur: Abhi mazeed range hasil ho sakti hai.

text.en: Ask for a light contraction against your hand and hold for 5 to 10 seconds
text.ur: Apne haath ke khilaf halki contraction maangein aur 5 se 10 second rokein

feedback.en: Yes — that is the contraction step; then relax and take up the new range.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh contraction ka qadam hai; phir relax karwa kar nayi range lein.

text.en: **Use it where it fits.** MET suits mild to moderate muscle tightness, a stiff joint after a short period of rest, and a patient who can follow instructions and relax. Retest the range after each round, and pair it with an exercise that keeps the new range.
text.ur: **Jahan fit ho wahan istemal karein.** MET halki se darmiyani muscle tightness, thore arse ki aaram ke baad akarhe hue joint, aur aise patient ke liye theek hai jo hidayat samjh aur relax kar sakte hon. Har round ke baad range dobara test karein, aur aisi exercise saath dein jo nayi range barqarar rakhe.

question.en: Why can a range improve right after MET even if the muscle is not physically longer?
question.ur: MET ke foran baad range behtar kyun ho sakti hai jabke muscle jismani taur par lamba nahi hota?

answer.en: Most of the early gain is likely from a change in stretch tolerance, reduced guarding and a calmer nervous system, rather than a change in muscle length. The range is real and useful, but the exact mechanism is still debated.
answer.ur: Shuruati faida zyada tar stretch tolerance ke badalne, guarding ke kam hone aur nervous system ke shaant hone se lagta hai, muscle ki lambai badalne se nahi. Range asli aur mufeed hai, lekin sahi mechanism par abhi bhi behes hai.

question.en: Which patient is a poor choice for MET today?
question.ur: Aaj kaun sa patient MET ke liye kam munasib hai?

text.en: A patient with a mildly tight hamstring after sport
text.ur: Khel ke baad halki tight hamstring wala patient

feedback.en: A mild tightness is a good use for MET.
feedback.ur: Halki tightness MET ka acha istemal hai.

text.en: A patient with a suspected acute muscle tear and severe pain
text.ur: Shak wala acute muscle tear aur shadeed dard wala patient

feedback.en: Right — severe pain and a suspected tear call for protection, not a contraction against resistance.
feedback.ur: Theek — shadeed dard aur shak wala tear protection maangte hain, resistance ke khilaf contraction nahi.

text.en: A patient with a stiff hip after a long flight
text.ur: Lambay flight ke baad akarha hua hip wala patient

feedback.en: A stiff but pain-free joint is suitable.
feedback.ur: Akarha hua lekin bina dard ka joint munasib hai.

beats.patient: A 30-year-old runner has a tight left hamstring with the straight leg raise stopping at 60° and a stretching ache behind the thigh.
beats.assessment: A mild muscle tightness without pain at rest, no bruising and no recent injury.
beats.treatment: Teach PIR: light contraction for 5 to 10 seconds, relax, take up the new range, three to five rounds, then re-measure.
beats.reassess: The range improves to 75° and the patient adds a daily gentle stretch and strengthening.

text.en: **Avoid MET** over a suspected fracture, an acute muscle or tendon tear, an unstable joint, an infected or inflamed joint, or a patient who cannot follow the instructions or relax. Stop if the contraction brings on sharp pain, numbness or dizziness.
text.ur: **MET se bachein** shak wale fracture, acute muscle ya tendon tear, unstable joint, infection ya sujan wale joint, ya aise patient par jo hidayat nahi samjh ya relax nahi kar sakta. Agar contraction se tez dard, sunn hona ya chakkar aaye to ruk jayein.

summary.en: MET uses a gentle patient-made contraction followed by relaxation to improve range: light effort, a short hold, then take up the slack.
summary.ur: MET patient ki banayi halki contraction aur phir relaxation se range behtar karta hai: halka effort, chhota hold, phir slack lein.

summary.en: PIR contracts the tight muscle; reciprocal inhibition contracts its opposite; both stay comfortable and are repeated three to five times.
summary.ur: PIR tight muscle ko contract karta hai; reciprocal inhibition uske ulte muscle ko; dono aaram se hote hain aur teen se paanch baar dohraye jate hain.

summary.en: The effect is real but its mechanism is debated; retest the range, keep it with exercise and avoid MET over fractures, tears or unstable joints.
summary.ur: Asar asli hai lekin mechanism par behes hai; range dobara test karein, exercise se barqarar rakhein aur fracture, tear ya unstable joint par MET se bachein.

front.en: What effort is used in a standard PIR contraction?
front.ur: Standard PIR contraction mein kitna effort hota hai?

back.en: A light effort, about 20% of maximum, held for 5 to 10 seconds.
back.ur: Halka effort, maximum ka takriban 20%, 5 se 10 second.

front.en: What is reciprocal inhibition in MET?
front.ur: MET mein reciprocal inhibition kya hai?

back.en: The patient contracts the opposite muscle (the antagonist), which is thought to calm the tight muscle so it lets go.
back.ur: Patient ulta muscle (antagonist) contract karta hai jisse tight muscle shaant hota mana jata hai.

front.en: How many repeats do you do?

back.en: Three to five rounds, then retest the range; stop when the range stops improving.
back.ur: Teen se paanch round, phir range dobara test karein; jab range behtar hona band ho to ruk jayein.

front.en: Why can the range improve even if the muscle is not longer?
front.ur: Muscle lamba na ho tab bhi range kyun behtar hoti hai?

back.en: Mostly because of better stretch tolerance and less guarding, not a change in muscle length.
back.ur: Zyada tar behtar stretch tolerance aur kam guarding se, muscle ki lambai badalne se nahi.

note.en: Measure the tightness before and after you treat.
note.ur: Ilaaj se pehle aur baad tightness naapein.

note.en: Another way to dose a manual technique.
note.ur: Manual technique ka dose dene ka doosra tareeqa.
